ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 revision, effective 1 January 2025), Articles 3-12; Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Legal Entities and Other Organizations (PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3 [2024], effective 1 November 2024), Articles 3-15; Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020); Measures for the Registration of Market Entities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies House or equivalent corporate registry in the foreign investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If the issuing state is a Hague Apostille Convention member: notarization followed by Apostille certification from the designated competent authority, then certified Chinese translation. If the issuing state is not a member: notarization, authentication by the foreign Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then Chinese consular legalization at the PRC Embassy or Consulate. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive and must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies House or equivalent corporate registry in the foreign investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path for Apostille Convention member states; consular legalization path for non-member states. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive; no sequential combination of Apostille and consular legalization is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney for WFOE Formation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign investor board of directors or corporate secretary, notarized by a local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path for Apostille Convention member states; consular legalization path for non-member states. The applicable path must be selected based on the country of issue and must not be combined with the other path.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association or Constitutional Instrument of Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign investor corporate secretary or corporate registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path for Apostille Convention member states; consular legalization path for non-member states. These routes are mutually exclusive; use only the route required by the origin jurisdiction.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank in the foreign investor's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path for Apostille Convention member states; consular legalization path for non-member states. Banks and PRC receiving authorities will reject a document that bears both Apostille and consular legalization because the routes are parallel and mutually exclusive.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All shareholders, UBOs, directors, senior managers and authorized signatories of the WFOE and foreign parent must be screened before any filing against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, US OFAC SDN List, EU and UK sanctions lists, PBOC/China anti-money laundering surveillance databases, and domestic enforcement and market-persons databases. PEPs are identified from government, political party, state-owned enterprise and international organization roles; enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth proof, senior management approval and annual review are mandatory. Any red flag requires immediate suspicious transaction reporting to China's Anti-Money Laundering Monitoring and Analysis Center and refusal or termination of the formation mandate. The firm should maintain audit trails of all screens for no less than five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Name Self-Declaration System operated by the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through local Municipal Market Supervision Administration online portals
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All official legal names must be in Simplified Chinese. English, pinyin and traditional Chinese characters are not accepted as the registered legal name. A WFOE name follows a mandatory four-tier structure: administrative division plus distinctive brand or transliterated investor name plus industry description plus organizational form. The foreign investor's name may be transliterated into Chinese with a certified translation and an explanatory declaration; Latin letters may appear only as an auxiliary trademark or approved abbreviation in the distinctive component and must be accompanied by the Chinese name. The industry component for this business should reflect digital creative, cultural technology, information services or game art production and must align with the approved ISIC 7490 scope.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon receiving a written name rejection from the local SAMR, the applicant must lodge an administrative appeal with the same Municipal Market Supervision Administration within 15 days, attaching the rejected name slip, trademark license, certified Chinese translation, and a factual explanation of the business scope. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may file administrative reconsideration with the provincial SAMR or municipal government within 60 days, and ultimately commence administrative litigation in the People's Court within 6 months. A new name application may be submitted immediately after exhaustion of the appeal route, and the reservation window may be refreshed by filing a new application before the current 30-day reservation expires.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office, commercial mailbox, or post-office-only registered address will not be accepted by PRC tax authorities, SAMR, or mainstream banks for a WFOE operating a game-art BPO because the place of business is a mandatory filing item and must match the physical location where management, artists, equipment and statutory books are present. Certain pilot districts permit cluster registration or address sharing for recognized technology and cultural creative enterprises, but the entity must maintain a physical production and management site and remain fully accessible for on-site inspection. Banks will require lease documentation, site visits, utility records and actual commercial substance before account opening. For this industry, reliance on a virtual office is operationally unacceptable and must be avoided.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 30-45% of unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first 12 months of registration. Checklist: original business license displayed; lease agreement with landlord identity and property ownership certificate; utility bills matching the registered address; payroll and social insurance records for employees; workstations, software licences and render equipment consistent with AAA game 3D art BPO; project contracts, invoices and accounting records; bank statements; legal representative or authorized local manager able to respond to inspectors. Municipal tax bureaus, SAMR and public security commercial administration officers may request immediate access to these records if the entity appears non-operational.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 23, 24, 26, 30, 32, 42, 46 and Chapter II; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China, Articles 2, 6, 13 and 15; Regulations for the Implementation of the Foreign Investment Law; 2023 Special Administrative Measures for the Access of Foreign Investment (Foreign Investment Negative List); Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Registration Administration of Market Entities.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration of the city/municipality of the registered office, acting under the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), through the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Establishment Registration Application Form for a Foreign-Invested Company and the fully executed Chinese-language Articles of Association of the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum registered capital is imposed on a general Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise under current PRC Company Law, provided the proposed business scope is not subject to the Foreign Investment Negative List. No blocked escrow account or compulsory upfront paid-in capital escrow arrangement is required for ISIC 7490 game art outsourcing. The registered capital amount, currency, shareholder contribution amounts and contribution schedule must be expressly stated in the Articles of Association and the Company Registration Application Form. Each shareholder's liability is limited to its subscribed capital. The capital may be contributed in installments according to the schedule, but the share capital must actually be transferred within the agreed schedule, cannot be withdrawn absent lawful reduction of capital, and non-compliance may trigger civil and administrative liability under Article 253 and related provisions of the Company Law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [CITY] WFOE LIMITED (THE 'COMPANY'), ADOPTED AT [ADDRESS], CHINA ON [DATE] AT [TIME]. A meeting of the Board of Directors was duly convened and held in accordance with the Articles of Association of the Company and the Company Law of the People's Republic of China. Each of the [NUMBER] directors then holding office was present in person or by proxy, and a quorum was confirmed. The Chairman opened the meeting, and the directors unanimously adopted the following resolutions. 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. RESOLVED, that the registered capital of the Company shall be [AMOUNT] [CURRENCY], divided into [NUMBER] ordinary shares with par value of [AMOUNT] each, and that the subscribers have irrevocably subscribed to such shares in accordance with the capital contribution schedule set out in the Articles of Association. RESOLVED FURTHER, that a share register shall be opened, share certificates signed by the Chairman and stamped with the Company seal shall be issued, and no distribution of profits shall be made unless the subscribed capital has been lawfully contributed and the statutory solvency condition is satisfied. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. RESOLVED, that the General Manager is authorized to open and operate banking and payment accounts, including wire transfer and PayPal settlement accounts, with licensed financial institutions; to sign and file all account opening documents, mandates, signature cards and electronic banking agreements; and to approve ordinary payment instructions. RESOLVED FURTHER, that any payment exceeding USD 10,000 or equivalent shall require two authorized signatories, namely the General Manager and the Finance Officer, unless the Board resolves otherwise for a specific transaction. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company shall be located at [ADDRESS], [CITY], [PROVINCE], CHINA, and that the General Manager shall execute, deliver and file the office lease agreement, landlord title certificate and landlord consent documents required by the Market Regulation authority in connection with the establishment registration. 4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. RESOLVED, that [NAME] be appointed as the first General Manager and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, with full authority to manage the ordinary business, enter into customer contracts, hire personnel and exercise all delegated management powers. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [NAME] be appointed as the Legal Representative of the Company, being the person authorized to represent the Company and to execute externally binding documents under the Company seal. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [NAME] be appointed as the Supervisor of the Company, with the statutory monitoring rights and audit access granted by the Company Law. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [NAME] be appointed as the Finance Officer and primary compliance officer responsible for tax, foreign exchange, labor, social insurance and operational regulatory filings. 5. GENERAL AUTHORIZATION. RESOLVED, that the General Manager and the Legal Representative, jointly or severally, are authorized to perform all incorporation acts, including filing with the State Administration for Market Regulation, engaging attorneys, accountants, translators and consultants, executing correspondence, paying statutory fees and disbursements, making non-material corrections to the registration application, and taking all lawful steps necessary to obtain the Business License and company seals. 6. CONTINUING MATTERS. RESOLVED, that following issuance of the Business License, the officers shall complete tax registration, social insurance registration, statistical reporting, foreign exchange registration, banking activation, seal engraving and all other post-incorporation formalities required by Chinese law. This resolution shall take effect immediately and shall be filed in the corporate records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Registration Name Reservation and Foreign Investment Negative List Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration under SAMR via the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform and the Market Entity Name Reservation System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a pre-registration name reservation through the Market Entity Name Reservation System of the local Market Supervision Administration. Select the enterprise type as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company and confirm that the proposed business scope of AAA game 3D art sculpting, character rigging and creative game art BPO services is outside the Foreign Investment Negative List. Enter up to five alternate company names, specify limited liability as the legal form, and electronically submit the identity information of all intended directors, the supervisor, and the proposed legal representative. The system will screen the names for prohibited words, confusion with existing enterprises, and national or regional restricted elements. Upon online approval, obtain the Name Reservation Notice, which is valid for six months and must be referenced in the later establishment application.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and detailed English description of proposed business scope
Electronic identity documents of intended legal representative, directors and supervisor
KYC/UBO declaration of the foreign parent and ultimate beneficial owner
Name reservation application form completed online
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is rejected, the system will provide the rejection reason; the applicant shall select an alternate name and resubmit without additional fee. If the registration authority issues a name query, submit a written explanatory letter and, if relevant, a trademark coexistence or authorization letter. If the name remains unavailable, select a new naming structure and reapply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Notarization and Authentication of Foreign Investor Documents and Local Incorporation Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local notary public in the foreign parent jurisdiction, PRC consular/legalization channels, and the local SAMR registration acceptance office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Chinese-language Articles of Association, the foreign parent's corporate resolution approving the establishment of the WFOE, and appointment letters designating the persons who will sign the Chinese registration documents on behalf of the foreign investor. All foreign public documents, including the parent company certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing or incumbency, and the foreign parent board resolution, must be notarized in the jurisdiction of the foreign parent and, where the issuing jurisdiction is a party to the Hague Apostille Convention, must bear an apostille; if the issuing state is not a party, the documents must be legalized by the competent PRC consulate. Foreign-language documents must be translated into Chinese by a qualified translation service, and the translation must be physically or digitally attached to the authenticated original. The registered address lease, landlord title certificate, written landlord consent and a descriptive floor plan of the office premises must be assembled. All signatures of the directors, legal representative and supervisor on the Articles and appointment forms must be notarized or witnessed as required by the local SAMR.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation of the foreign investor
Foreign parent board or shareholder resolution approving the WFOE establishment
Certificate of incumbency or good standing for the foreign investor
Notarized and apostilled or consular legalized parent documents
Chinese translation of all foreign-language documents
Articles of Association of the WFOE in Chinese
Lease agreement for the registered office, landlord title certificate and landlord consent
Appointment letters for legal representative, directors, supervisor and general manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration authority determines that authentication is defective, promptly obtain the correct apostille or consular legalization and a corrected certified translation, then resubmit through the case-correction channel within the prescribed correction period. If any document is challenged, file a notarized explanatory statement from the foreign parent and amend the affected corporate instruments before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: SAMR Establishment Filing and Business License Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration through the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform or the local enterprise registration service hall
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the Name Reservation Notice and assembling the complete dossier, execute the Company Establishment Registration Application Form in accordance with the SAMR electronic filing procedure. Upload the Articles of Association, the name reservation notice, identity documents, registered address proof, authenticated foreign parent documents, appointment resolutions, and signed declaration forms. Complete electronic signature by all directors and the legal representative using the platform's verified digital identity tool. Review the registered capital amount and contribution schedule, the exact business scope wording, the governance structure, and the legal representative's identity before final submission. No government filing fee is charged for WFOE establishment registration. The SAMR will examine the filing, and once approved it will issue the electronic Business License; the physical Business License may be collected in person or by authorized courier at the designated service window.
required_dossiers: Fully executed Company Establishment Registration Application Form
Fully executed Articles of Association of the WFOE
Name Reservation Notice
Authenticated foreign parent corporate documents and certified Chinese translations
Passport or ID copies of legal representative, directors, supervisor and general manager
Office lease, landlord title certificate and landlord consent
Foreign Investment Negative List declaration and business scope statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SAMR issues a correction notice, the applicant must rectify the specified items through the online portal within 15 days. If the application is returned because the business scope is broader than the permitted scope, narrow the wording and resubmit. If the authority formally refuses registration, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration within 60 days or file an administrative lawsuit within six months, and may in parallel submit a new registration application with corrected materials.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Seal Engraving, Tax Registration, Social Insurance and Banking Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-registered seal engraving enterprise; local office of the State Taxation Administration; social insurance and housing fund registration authorities; designated bank acting under SAFE foreign exchange administration rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after issuance of the Business License, instruct a Public Security Bureau-registered seal engraving enterprise to engrave the company official seal, finance seal, contract seal, invoice seal and legal representative name seal. Complete tax registration with the State Taxation Administration through the electronic tax bureau application, register for the applicable taxes, elect the invoicing regime, and obtain taxpayer identification confirmation. Complete social insurance and housing fund registration with the local authorities and file labor contracts for all initial employees. If the foreign parent will remit registered capital, complete foreign exchange filing or registration through the designated bank under SAFE rules, open a foreign currency capital account and a Renminbi basic deposit account, and establish payment settlement accounts supporting wire transfer and PayPal rails. Before commencing active operations, verify that the office premises hold the landlord's fire safety acceptance certificate and that all statutory filings are in order.
required_dossiers: Business License (electronic and physical)
SAMR approval notice or certificate of establishment registration
Name reservation notice and corporate registration dossier
Legal representative and finance officer identity documents
Company seal engraving application form approved by PSB
Tax registration application and information form
Social insurance registration application and employee payroll list
FDI registration or filing forms for the designated bank under SAFE rules
Office lease, landlord fire safety certificate and site use confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority or bank requires enhanced due diligence, provide updated ultimate beneficial ownership information, evidence of business substance such as office lease, payroll and service contracts, and an anti-money-laundering explanation of the payment rails used. If the PSB seal engraving unit requests additional material, obtain the required identity verification and formal authorization letter from the legal representative, then request re-engraving.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - the entity is not a physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly or warehousing establishment under ISIC 1xxx, 2xxx, 3xxx, 4xxx or 52xx; the registered scope is ISIC 7490 digital creative game 3D art outsourcing, characterized as software-based creative services with no industrial plant or production line.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no separate municipal industrial operating permit is required for a purely digital 3D art outsourcing studio; the SAMR Business License together with tax, social insurance, statistical and foreign exchange registrations constitutes the complete statutory authorization matrix.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - no physical construction, industrial installation or land-changing project is triggered under the Environmental Impact Assessment Law of the People's Republic of China; the local ecological environment bureau has no EIA filing obligation for this business category.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from statutory EIA classification - the activity does not fall within the EIA Classification List of Construction Projects of the PRC, and no Class A or Class B EIA report is required for an office-based digital art studio.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable for production discharges; ordinary domestic sewage from office use shall comply with municipal sewer discharge standards and local drainage permits where applicable, electronic office waste shall be collected separately under municipal solid-waste rules, and no VOC, chemical effluent or hazardous industrial waste process thresholds are triggered.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable as an industrial Civil Defense fire permit because the studio operates no hazardous storage, high-risk production process or warehousing activity. The lessor must nevertheless provide the Certificate of Fire Safety Inspection issued by the Fire Rescue Authority for the leased commercial building, and the employer shall comply with occupational safety, fire evacuation and workplace health requirements applicable to general office premises before commencing operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); online electronic portal is the unified Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) platform operated by the STA and accessed through provincial and municipal tax service bureaus.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Under Mainland China's multi-credential integration regime, the statutory tax identification number (TIN) for a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise is the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) embedded in the SAMR business license; no separate VAT ID is issued. The foreign-invested WFOE and its non-resident shareholders must proceed as follows. 1. The foreign investor obtains the WFOE business license from the State Administration for Market Regulation using notarized and legalized corporate existence documents, board resolutions, articles of association, registered address proof, and legal representative identity documentation. 2. Upon license issuance, SAMR transfers the registration record electronically to the STA, which automatically creates the WFOE taxpayer account using the USCC as the TIN. 3. The WFOE legal representative and designated tax officer complete supplementary tax registration through the e-Tax platform within 30 calendar days, declaring accounting system details, domestic bank account, parent/shareholder particulars, business scope, VAT taxpayer type, and applicable VAT rate category. 4. The e-Tax account is activated, invoice quotas are set, and the WFOE obtains the tax-control digital certificate and encryption credentials required to issue fully digitalized electronic VAT invoices through the STA National Unified Electronic Invoice Service Platform. 5. Foreign non-resident shareholders that do not carry on a Chinese business are not issued a separate mainland TIN; for China-source income such as dividends, royalties, or service fees, the WFOE withholds and remits the tax and the local STA records the foreign shareholder identity in the withholding filing reference. 6. Any change to legal representative, registered address, capital structure, business scope, or bank account must be reported through the e-Tax platform within 30 days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - The WFOE is a Chinese tax resident enterprise taxed at the entity level under the Enterprise Income Tax Law on its worldwide income; no flow-through or partnership treatment is available to the foreign shareholders. For VAT, the WFOE is a separate taxpayer classified as a small-scale VAT taxpayer or a general VAT taxpayer depending on annual taxable sales.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Mainland China does not provide a check-the-box entity classification election for a WFOE limited liability company, no elective pass-through status, and no domestic hybrid mismatch election. The STA may recharacterize an arrangement under substance-over-form, controlled-foreign-company, thin capitalization, and general anti-avoidance rules if hybrid structures create unintended tax benefits.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the State Taxation Administration, with a standard headline VAT rate of 13% for general goods, 9% for specified goods, 6% for modern services (which applies domestically to this game art outsourcing studio), and 0% for qualified cross-border exports of services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000 (or the then-current statutory small-scale taxpayer threshold) in any consecutive 12-month period triggers mandatory registration as a general VAT taxpayer; below the threshold the WFOE may remain a small-scale taxpayer subject to simplified VAT calculation. VAT taxpayer registration is integrated with the business license, so the threshold primarily determines general versus small-scale classification and invoice credit entitlement.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The WFOE is required to issue fully digitalized electronic VAT invoices through the STA National Unified Electronic Invoice Service Platform. Invoices carry an encrypted digital signature and anti-forgery QR code and are uploaded to the STA Golden Tax system in near real-time at issuance. Large-scale issuers must integrate their ERP systems through the standard STA data-exchange and API protocol; invoice data is automatically reconciled against the VAT return, invoice credit pool, and customer/vendor profiles to detect volume spikes, split-billing, and cross-border mismatches. There is no manual printing of fully digitalized invoices, and the tax authority can block invoice quotas or trigger on-site inspection when anomaly indicators are met.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating or exemption for the cross-border supply of 3D game art, sculpting, rigging, and creative asset services is available when the services are supplied to an overseas client for consumption entirely outside Mainland China. The WFOE must evidence that no domestic consumer exists, the contract is in the name of a non-resident principal, the work product is delivered and used offshore, and the consideration is received in a permitted foreign exchange currency through an onshore bank channel. The statutory framework includes Caishui [2016] No. 36 and STA Announcement No. 29 of 2016 governing cross-border taxable services. If the service qualifies as an export zero-rated service, output VAT is charged at 0% and input VAT attributable to that export may be refunded; if it qualifies only as an exempt cross-border service, output VAT is not charged but corresponding input VAT is not refundable. Proceeds collected through digital payment rails such as PayPal must be swept into the WFOE onshore domestic bank account and settled through SAFE-designated foreign exchange procedures before the zero-rating can be substantiated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Goods Declaration Form issued by the General Administration of Customs of China for any physical deliverables accompanying the service, such as sample models, hard drives, or art assets.
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or logistics handover certificate evidencing physical export movement when goods, prototypes, data storage devices, or printed art assets cross the border.
Cross-border service agreement or work order showing the overseas client, scope of 3D art production, ownership of intellectual property, delivery terms, and offshore consumption clause.
Commercial invoice issued from the e-Tax system, clearly marked as export zero-rated or exempt service, matching the contract currency and receivable amount.

Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC), bank inward remittance advice, or foreign exchange settlement receipt from a SAFE-designated bank evidencing actual receipt and conversion of the export proceeds from the non-resident client.

Client acceptance certificate, milestone sign-off, handover log, or digital delivery confirmation, supported by the non-resident client business registration or tax residency certificate, proving that the deliverable was transferred to and consumed outside Mainland China.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA collaborates with the General Administration of Customs and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange in joint risk reviews using Golden Tax system data, customs export records, and foreign exchange receipt systems. If the zero-rating claim is audited and any document in the substantiation bundle is false, incomplete, or inconsistent, the WFOE must immediately unwind the zero rating and pay output VAT at the applicable domestic rate, generally 6% for its modern services, plus a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% of the tax due per day and an administrative penalty ranging from 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax where the underpayment is characterized as evasion or fraud. In serious cases, false issuance of VAT invoices or fraudulent export-tax-refund claims carries criminal liability under the Criminal Law, cancellation of export-refund facilities, loss of input VAT deductions, inclusion on the tax-integrity blacklist, and retrospective clawbacks. The tax authority may reopen underpaid or false zero-rated transactions for three to five years under the Tax Collection Administration Law, and for fraud or evasion the recovery period is not closed until the tax, interest, and penalties are fully collected.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The People's Bank of China (PBoC) as the central bank, with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) as the designated foreign exchange control regulator
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is convertible on current account under China's IMF Article VIII undertakings, meaning export service receipts for 3D game art, such as WFOE invoices for sculpting and rigging services, can be received and settled through licenced banks after trade authenticity verification. Capital account items remain restricted. A WFOE's initial capital injection requires SAFE's foreign direct investment registration, a dedicated FDI capital account and a specific approved purpose. Subsequent profit remittances to the overseas parent are classified as current account investment income but remain operationally controlled: they are permitted only after audited financial statements show genuine distributable profits, statutory reserves have been appropriated, enterprise income tax has been settled, tax clearance certificates have been obtained, and the remitting bank and SAFE have verified the board resolution. Dividends cannot be remitted in advance of profits, and settled capital funds cannot be diverted into prohibited uses such as domestic securities, real estate speculative investment, or non-operating loans. The bank will also monitor settlement volumes against the WFOE's declared business scope, payroll, and operating expenses to prevent shell-company operations. In practice, convertibility is therefore readily available for genuine trade and service flows but remains tightly verified and subject to administrative review, particularly for related-party payments and year-end profit repatriation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods and service export proceeds, the WFOE must repatriate all foreign exchange earnings onshore through a licenced Chinese bank, normally within 180 days from the payment date or the commercial maturity schedule agreed in the export contract. There is no fixed mandatory conversion ratio after settlement because SAFE abolished forced surrender; the company may retain the foreign currency in a foreign exchange current-account settlement account or convert it into RMB at the bank's prevailing market rate. However, all receipts must be traceable to real trade and must be reported under SAFE's trade monitoring system using the correct service-trade BOP code. Any transaction without an underlying contract, invoice, or deliverable evidence will be rejected, and after conversion the WFOE must keep sufficient current-account records to demonstrate the flow from foreign client funds to domestic operating accounts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI capital account, foreign exchange current-account settlement account, RMB basic deposit account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Viability is very low and legally not feasible as a primary account. Offshore fintech electronic money institutions are not licensed under PRC banking and foreign-exchange regulations to hold a WFOE's corporate RMB account, to operate an FDI capital account, or to file current-account trade data with SAFE. PayPal can be used only as a downstream collection channel that ultimately settles into a domestic Chinese commercial bank account; Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, and similar EMIs cannot act as the WFOE's main clearing rail for capital injection or statutory KYC. Any advertising of global EMI accounts must not be used for SAFE-regulated cross-border flows unless the institution holds a valid domestic payment institution licence and the settlement remains in a licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical branch appearance is effectively mandatory for corporate account opening. The foreign legal representative must either attend the designated branch in mainland China with the original passport, board resolution, company seal card, and articles of association, or, if unable to travel, must appoint a locally resident authorised signatory with a notarised and consular-legalised power of attorney. Remote 100% digital account opening is not accepted for WFOE accounts; video verification can supplement, but it cannot replace the live or locally authorised in-branch KYC interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership chain opacity: the WFOE is owned by a foreign corporate parent whose ultimate beneficial owner is not visible from Chinese public records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide certificate of incumbency, register of directors and shareholders from the parent and all intermediate holding companies, notarised constitutional documents with English-Chinese translations, a source-of-funds statement for the capital contribution, audited parent financial statements, foreign bank reference letter, and a signed corporate structure chart demonstrating each UBO and percentage of control.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border intangible service revenue authenticity: 3D art outsourcing revenue may be assessed as unquantifiable digital services and could be seen as transfer mispricing or round-tripping.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the executed work statements and service-level agreements for each game art project, delivery logs and handover certificates, 3D metadata or render manifests showing project timestamps, per-client invoices and payment reconciliation, a transfer pricing file adequate under Chinese filing thresholds, proof of VAT zero-rated export filing, and correspondence showing client acceptance for each milestone.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Related-party inbound capital injection from an overseas holding company or founder loan may trigger capital-account scrutiny and purpose-code mismatch checks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the SAFE foreign direct investment registration certificate, foreign investment project filing or clearance, board resolution approving the capital injection, the signed share subscription agreement, evidence of the actual business need such as payroll schedule, studio lease, render-farm costs, and a source-of-funds package from the overseas remitting entity, including audited financials and bank statements showing legitimate accumulation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Concentrated PayPal settlements from overseas clients may be interpreted as money laundering or undisclosed e-commerce activity rather than a managed art-outsourcing business.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver PayPal business account statements with transaction-level identifiers, a reconciliation ledger mapping each PayPal receipt to a named client and project, corresponding service contracts and invoices, proof of digital delivery such as upload logs, work order ticketing, and client release emails, audit trails of the game art content, and an annual AML compliance declaration signed by the local finance and compliance managers.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The overseas parent should remit through SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's designated FDI capital account at a licenced domestic bank, matching the beneficiary account name with the SAFE-registered corporate name. The remitter instruction must carry the SAFE-approved BOP purpose code for direct investment equity capital injection, not a goods-trade code. The receiving bank will file the collection with SAFE in the capital account monitoring system and allow settlement into RMB only after background checks and negative-list screening. A Chinese certified public accountant must then issue a capital verification report using the bank receipt, the SAFE registration certificate, and the board's capital contribution resolution as source documents. Funds cannot be withdrawn or repaid through the current account, and no cash, PayPal, or third-party wallet route may be used for FDI capital injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For service disbursements such as freelance artist royalties, cloud-rendering subscriptions and software licences, the standard rail is SWIFT MT103 with full beneficiary remittance fields and supporting commercial contracts, invoices and tax records; CIPS can be used for cross-border RMB payments to the WFOE's overseas counterparties. A commercial documentary letter of credit or documentary collection is appropriate only for tangible purchases such as graphics workstations or licensed hardware, where title documents, packing lists, and bills of lading can support the bank presentation. The WFOE should maintain a disbursement policy requiring two signatories, tax withholding where applicable, and a SAFE-clean invoice trail for any service payment, especially to related parties.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable onshore FX forward contracts with licenced Chinese banks, supported by genuine trade or service-export exposure and a documented underlying contract.
FX swaps with a licenced bank for the same RMB/USD or RMB/other major currency exposure, limited to working capital and trade-related cash flow needs.

Cross-currency swaps for structured matching of long-term USD-denominated game art receivables against RMB-denominated payroll and studio operating costs, subject to SAFE-compliant underlying exposure evidence.
NDFs are not permissible onshore; hedging must be deliverable, and speculative derivative positions unrelated to the WFOE's actual commercial flows are prohibited.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report (annual return and corporate declaration under the Interim Regulations on Enterprise Information Publicity)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 in each calendar year, covering the immediately preceding fiscal year; hard deadline June 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If not filed by June 30, the enterprise is placed on the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations and publicly flagged; after three consecutive years of non-rectification, it moves to the List of Seriously Untrustworthy Enterprises, triggering multi-agency disciplinary restrictions, procurement bans, tax treatment downgrades, and possible administrative revocation of the business license by SAMR; no normal monetary fine applies but credit and license sanctions are severe.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Annual Information Report (annual FDI declaration under the PRC Foreign Investment Law)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the integrated SAMR/MOFCOM internet annual-report portal; information is shared with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 in each calendar year for the prior year; hard deadline June 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file triggers a written rectification order from the commerce authority; failure to rectify triggers a fine of RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000, possible inclusion on the abnormal operations list, and restriction from certain government and tax benefits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Settlement and Reconciliation (annual CIT return and final closing filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) via the local tax bureau electronic filing system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within five calendar months after the end of each tax year; for a calendar-year WFOE, no later than May 31 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of RMB 2,000 in ordinary cases and up to RMB 10,000 in serious cases; unpaid tax accrues a late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day; under-declaration caused by inaccurate books triggers a penalty of 50% to 500% of the unpaid tax; severe or repeated violations may escalate to tax crime liability, credit rating downgrade, and coordinated license revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory audit of annual financial statements by a PRC-licensed CPA and presentation for shareholder approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not a filed government return; audited statements are kept at the registered office and must be produced to SAMR, tax authorities, and foreign-exchange regulators when demanded
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of the financial year, and in practice aligned with the annual report filing and CIT settlement deadlines, normally no later than May 31 for tax purposes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to obtain the statutory audit violates the PRC Company Law and Accounting Law, exposing the entity to regulatory rectification orders, shareholder remedies, inability to lawfully publish corporate annual report financial data, and adverse audit consequences in any subsequent tax or foreign-exchange inspection.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All PRC limited-liability companies, including a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, are unconditionally required to have annual financial statements independently audited by a PRC-licensed certified public accountant under the PRC Company Law; no balance-sheet, turnover, asset, or headcount threshold exists to waive this obligation, so even a low-revenue 3D art outsourcing WFOE is statutorily audited each fiscal year.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE / China GAAP), issued by the Ministry of Finance and largely converged with IFRS; qualifying small enterprises may apply the Small Enterprise Accounting Standards, but a WFOE is conservatively expected to use full ASBE; IFRS or overseas parent reporting is supplementary and cannot substitute for the separate PRC statutory audit in RMB and Chinese bookkeeping.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Mainland China does not maintain a public UBO register equivalent to common law jurisdictions; beneficial ownership and ultimate investor data are reported annually through the Foreign Investment Annual Information Report to MOFCOM and through AML customer due diligence to banking and tax regulators. Any shareholding transfer, change of actual controller, or direct ownership modification must be registered with SAMR within 30 days of the event, and the updated foreign investment report is confirmed in the next annual filing cycle no later than June 30.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $600 - $4,500 per year for a virtual or policy-supported business park registered address in major Chinese cities; a full physical office lease is substantially higher and is not an agent-only charge
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $1,500 - $7,000 per certified audit engagement for a typical WFOE of this size and business complexity; the fee rises with consolidation, transfer pricing documentation, IFRS conversion, or group audit instructions

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying High-Tech Enterprise reduced rate 15%; Small Low-Profit Enterprise preferential effective rate 5% on annual taxable income up to RMB 3 million; additional 100% Research & Development super-deduction for qualifying R&D expenditures; Hainan Free Trade Port encouraged-industry 15% rate and certain regional preferential regimes if the WFOE is registered in an eligible zone.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return for Enterprise Income Tax (Form A) also referenced as Form A200000, filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration e-Tax Application portal (China Tax E-Filing System).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return with quarterly provisional prepayments during the year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return must be filed and settled by May 31 of the year following the fiscal year-end; quarterly provisional tax payments are due within 15 days after each quarter end (April 15, July 15, October 15 and January 15). A non-calendar fiscal year requires prior State Taxation Administration approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue / operating income from all sources.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide business income on an accrual basis, including all game 3D art sculpting, character rigging and outsourcing contract revenue. Ensure foreign-currency receipts are converted using the exchange rate quoted on the last day of the taxable year or the actual settlement date as approved by the tax authority. Cross-border contracts must be mapped to delivery milestones to avoid artificial deferral of income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales / direct cost of main business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only directly incurred outsourcing, labor and materials costs supported by genuine invoices and contracts. Any subcontracted service payments to offshore related parties must satisfy the arm's-length standard; related-party subcontractor fees must be supported by a contemporaneous transfer pricing study or the deduction may be reversed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating profit / accounting profit after operating expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile to statutory Chinese GAAP financial statements. Identify non-deductible expenses such as unrealistic management fees, excessive intercompany royalties or entertainment expenditures. The tax authority will recharacterize inflated cross-border charges if the WFOE lacks economic substance to bear those costs.

Add back non-deductible provisions, penalties, and outbound payments that fail the valid invoice or substance tests. Deduct only allowable R&D expenses, employment social insurance contributions and lawful depreciation. Cross-border service charges must be benchmarked under the approved transfer pricing methods.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses carried forward from prior years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offset current taxable income with prior-year unabsorbed losses within the statutory five-year carryforward period; a ten-year period is available for qualifying High-Tech Enterprises. Losses originating in am empty shell WFOE with no substantive business activities may be disregarded on a substance-over-form challenge.

This is the final base for applying the headline 25% rate, reduced to 15% for High-Tech Enterprises or to the applicable effective rate for Small Low-Profit Enterprises. If a non-resident parent exercises de facto control over transfer prices, the tax authority may re-determine this amount under Chapter 6 special tax adjustment rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable tax rate, calculated enterprise income tax and additional income tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the standard 25% statutory rate, or the preferential rate if a valid High-Tech Enterprise certificate or small low-profit qualification exists. Include lawful foreign tax credits for Chinese-source? For the WFOE resident entity, credit is available for foreign income taxes paid on foreign-source income only on a per-country limitation basis.

Mandatory disclosure of all intercompany transactions with offshore parent, sister and service-affiliate companies, including technology licenses, trademark royalties, management fees, loans, and advance payments for game art services. The form must identify the transfer pricing method used; failure to disclose will trigger a special tax investigation and penalty exposure.

Claim the additional 100% R&D deduction only for qualifying scientific R&D expenditures directly relating to the WFOE's game-art technology, rigging algorithms or pipeline tools. Non-resident shareholders must ensure that R&D activities and decision-making personnel are actually located in China; a remote R&D attribution to the foreign parent will invalidate the claim.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Outbound remittance and withholding information cross-reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Although dividend withholding is declared separately, the annual return must reconcile all profit distributions, deemed dividends and retained earnings remittances. A WFOE failing to disclose accrued dividends payable to its non-resident shareholder may face re-characterization as a constructive dividend and mandatory 10% withholding tax recovery.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual enterprise income tax return may result in an administrative fine of RMB 2,000 or up to RMB 10,000 for serious cases, plus a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on unpaid tax. Understatement of taxable income due to false invoices, sham contracts or transfer pricing manipulation exposes the WFOE to a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax under the Tax Collection Law Article 63, interest on the underpayment, public announcement of tax violations, blacklisting and exit restrictions on responsible directors. Criminal tax evasion is triggered when the amount evaded exceeds RMB 50,000 and is greater than 10% of the tax payable, carrying imprisonment up to seven years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory enterprise income tax withholding on dividends paid by a resident enterprise to a non-resident enterprise shareholder, subject to reduction under applicable bilateral double tax treaties, e.g. 5% under the China-Hong Kong DTA where the Hong Kong resident beneficial owner holds at least 25% of the WFOE's capital.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim reduced withholding tax under a Double Tax Treaty, the non-resident shareholder or its Chinese withholding agent must file the Non-resident Taxpayer Claim for Tax Treaty Benefits before or at the time of the offshore remittance. The claim requires a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the residence-country tax authority, a completed beneficial owner statement proving that the recipient is not a conduit, supporting evidence of substantive business activity in the residence state, and the underlying share registration and distribution declaration. The in-charge Chinese tax authority may grant treaty relief only after reviewing substance and commercial rationality under the general anti-avoidance rule; back-to-back arrangements or shell holding companies will be denied treaty access and the full 10% statutory rate applied.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and interest paid to a non-resident enterprise each carry a statutory withholding rate of 10%. Under many DTAs, interest may be reduced to 5% or 10% and royalties to 5% or 10%, depending on the treaty article and the beneficial ownership test. Intercompany loans must respect arm's-length interest rates and China thin-capitalization rules: interest on related-party debt exceeding the debt-to-equity safe harbour of 2:1 (or 5:1 for financial institutions) is non-deductible and may be re-characterized as a dividend with 10% withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory when annual related-party tangible asset transfers exceed RMB 200 million, or intangible asset transfers exceed RMB 100 million, or financial asset transfers exceed RMB 100 million, or other related-party transactions exceed RMB 40 million. Master File must be prepared when the WFOE belongs to a multinational group whose prior-year consolidated revenue exceeds RMB 5.5 billion or whose total related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China applies a substance-over-form requirement and the beneficial ownership test for treaty and withholding matters. Although China does not operate a standalone Economic Substance Regulations filing regime, the WFOE must demonstrate core income-generating activities actually performed in China, including operational decision-making, risk-bearing, employee headcount, office premises and bank accounts. If the WFOE is a mere invoice shell with no real activity, the State Taxation Administration may re-characterize income, deny treaty benefits, impute a deemed dividend to the foreign parent and impose special tax adjustment interest.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE has no employees, no office, no business records and no core income-generating activities in China; it earns game-art outsourcing revenue and immediately remits nearly all profits to a non-resident parent or a Hong Kong or offshore affiliate under a treaty benefit claim, without satisfying the beneficial owner and tax residence tests.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty relief, re-application of 10% statutory withholding tax, re-characterization of the entire income under the General Anti-Avoidance Rule (Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 47 and Article 120), additional tax with interest, and a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax under Tax Collection Law Article 63.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly used the shell WFOE to channel profits and misuse treaty relief will face civil asset restitution to the Chinese fisc, joint and several liability for the unpaid tax if corporate assets are stripped, travel bans and blacklisting in the tax integrity system, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201 with imprisonment of up to seven years where the evaded amount crosses the criminal threshold.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE enters into non-arm's-length arrangements with its foreign parent or affiliate, such as paying excessive royalties for game design know-how, booking fake management or IT service fees, selling digital art assets below market price, or tolerating chronic under-pricing of its rendering and rigging services while leaving the WFOE in persistent low profit or loss.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority may make an adjusted assessment under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 41 and Article 44, reprice the related-party transactions using the most appropriate arm's-length method, disallow excessive deductions, impose a 5% per annum interest charge on the underpayment, and apply penalties of 50% to 500% of underpaid tax where the behavior constitutes tax evasion; refusal to produce contemporaneous documentation also triggers a penalty under Article 121 of the Tax Collection Law implementing measures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who designed or signed the manipulated contracts face personal civil liability for restitution, blacklisting and exit bans under cross-border tax enforcement cooperation, and criminal imprisonment if the underpayment is knowingly concealed through false documentation; courts may pierce the corporate veil to reach personal and family assets when the WFOE is found to be a mere instrumentality of the foreign shareholder.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Disguised profit repatriation / failure to withhold dividends
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE distributes profits to its non-resident shareholder by labeling them as purported service fees, unsecured shareholder loans, intercompany payables or technical consulting charges instead of declaring a formal dividend, thereby avoiding the 10% dividend withholding tax and failing to file the withholding tax return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority re-characterizes the disguised remittance as a dividend and imposes 10% withholding tax on the entire amount, recovers unpaid withholding tax from the WFOE as withholding agent, adds late-payment surcharge at 0.05% per day, and imposes a penalty of 50% to 500% of the unpaid withholding tax under Tax Collection Law Article 63 and Article 69.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who directed the fake service or loan scheme are personally liable for the un-collected withholding tax if the WFOE cannot pay, face civil asset restitution and freezing of personal bank accounts, are subjected to travel restriction and blacklisting as serious tax violators, and may be sentenced to up to seven years' imprisonment for tax evasion where the disguised dividend scheme intentionally misleads the tax authority.
